name: University of Central Florida
description:
The University of Central Florida was founded in 1963, opening five years later as Florida Technological University. The aim was to provide personnel to support the US space program at the nearby Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. While it remains â€œAmericaâ€™s Space Universityâ€_x009d_ its focus has expanded and it became a university in 1978.

It has 70,000 students each year across its 13 colleges and over 230 degree programs, this includes international students from 157 countries. The University of Central Florida has ranked in the top 400 worldwide universities in the Academic Ranking of World Universities and 47th in the country according to Washington Monthly.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Founded in 1963, the University of Central Florida (UCF) is one of the largest public research universities in the United States. UCF maintains space connections through managing and leading various space and astronomy organisations and centres, such as the Florida Space Institute, Robinson Observatory, and more.

Furthermore, UCF is classified among "R1: Doctoral Universities - Very high research activity" and is accredited by the Commission on Colleges of the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: UCF offers you countless opportunities for learning and engagement, both in and out of the classroom. It gives you a vibrant and friendly campus environment, with a diverse student body of approximately 3000 students. It is home to over 3,400 international students from 137 countries. Even more, it has the fourth-largest on-campus student body of any public university in the United States.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Central Florida offers a variety of on-campus accommodation options. The various accommodation types include residence hall suites, apartment-style housing, and Greek housing in different living communities. All options are located near the campus for easy commuting.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The university’s main library, the John C. Hitt Library, is massive! It has over 2 million printed books, a ton of e-books, and electronic journals. They also have special collections for specific topics. The library also provides extensive research assistance. The library is always improving and adding new spaces for students to work together and study.

Sports
UCF has a wide array of sports facilities for recreation and competitive athletes. The UCF Recreation and Wellness Centre features fitness equipment, swimming pools, basketball courts, and multipurpose rooms for group classes. UCF also offers numerous sports leagues and club teams, allowing you to participate in various sports activities throughout the academic year.

Laboratory
UCF provides state-of-the-art laboratory facilities across multiple disciplines. The university has specialised labs for biology, chemistry, physics, and engineering. These labs are equipped with advanced technology to help you with hands-on learning and research.

Cafeteria
Dining options at UCF are diverse, with various meal plans available! The primary dining hall offers a variety of meal options, including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free choices. You can enjoy buffet-style dining with rotating menus that feature international cuisines. In addition to the main cafeteria, there are multiple food courts across the campus with popular food chains and vendors.
